messages:
jordan: Heads-up — product planning sync: we need a final convention for request/response metadata before we freeze the public API for H2 roadmap. My proposal: top-level `request_id`, `client_id` (nullable), `tokens.input`, `tokens.output`, `tokens.total`, `model_trace_id`, and a small `meta` object for vendor-specific fields. Thoughts?
jackie: I like explicit token fields. quick q: do we call it `token_usage` or `tokens`? analytics currently uses `token_usage`.
sam: prefer `tokens.{input,output,total}` — maps cleanly to runtime counters. also: avoid allowing arbitrary nested `meta` at top-level; security will ask for a whitelist.
marta: privacy note — `client_id` can be PII. recommend `client_hash` and require hashing in docs (salted) if customers send anything user-identifying.
riley: backwards-compat concern: a lot of clients already parse `token_usage`. can we support both names for a transition period? otherwise SDKs will break.
jordan: OK to support server-side aliases for 6 months; canonical name in docs will be `tokens`. include migration notes in the PR.
sam: on traces & tooling: runtime produces `trace_id` at request ingress and `span_id` for sub-ops. propose canonical fields: `trace_id` (string), `span_id` (optional string), `trace_flags` (optional). also include `parent_trace_id` for tool/function call linking.
jackie: structured outputs need a small schema block. propose: `structured_output.format` (e.g. `json-schema-v1`), `structured_output.validation` with `errors: []` and `valid: boolean`. Examples in docs please.
marta: one more privacy item — never log full prompts by default. add `prompt_digest` (sha256 or similar) for correlation instead of raw prompt. call out telemetry opt-in. :lock: 
sam: for tool/function calling we should capture minimal metrics: `tool_calls`: array of `{tool_name, duration_ms, success, trace_id}`. question: do we include token counts per tool call? that could be large.
riley: agree with sampling. API should return aggregated `tokens` at top-level and allow `tool_usage.tokens` only if `include_detailed_usage=true` in request.
devops-bot: note: api change flagged for 2026-06-01 freeze window — plan sprints accordingly.
jordan: launch criteria checklist for this change: 1) spec PR merged to repo; 2) server-side alias layer active; 3) SDKs map old->new names; 4) security & privacy sign-off; 5) migration guide + sample cURL snippets; 6) e2e test with canary traffic. target: end of next sprint.
jackie: I'll draft the spec PR and RFC with concrete examples and code snippets. assigning: @sam to implement aliasing, @riley to update API surface docs and sample payloads, @marta to run privacy checklist.
riley: noted — I'll add embedding examples showing `tokens.input` only. also will add migration examples for common client libs.
sam: small technical nit: embeddings should set `tokens.output = 0` (integer) and `tokens.total = tokens.input`. We'll declare `tokens.*` as integers in the spec.
jordan: confirmed — token fields are integers. Jackie: aim to open PR by EOD Friday so we have time for review.
marta: will review privacy section by Thursday and flag any blockers. thanks everyone.
